title: The Episode About the Hill chief of Kebloor

blocks.text: After the conquest, rulers submit, revenue begins to flow, and Banda’s prestige grows beyond simple battle fame into administrative and spiritual authority.
People now come before him with requests, offerings, and petitions, and the poet stresses how public declarations and nakib-style announcements spread his renown.
The word nakib signals this new phase: Banda is now not only a fighter but a proclaimed power whose reputation is broadcast outward.
